feeds.title: Healthy Paws Pet Insurance
feeds.description: Healthy Paws Pet Insurance & Foundation helps you keep your dog or cat healthy and happy while protecting your hard-earned savings from the costs of unexpected medical care. But helping you care for your pet is just part of our story.

feeds.title: Canine Journal
feeds.description: At Canine Journal we focus on gathering firsthand, well-researched, expert knowledge on any given niche area from pets to pet gifts. Our pet experts (including a licensed vet and insurance professional) are dedicated to bringing you the latest industry news and reviewing the industry's most reputable products and services. Get the most in-depth, unbiased review of any given product, service, or category related to dogs.

feeds.title: Petcover
feeds.description: Petcover is an Australian pet insurance company with 30 years of experience. Petplan AU is solely focused on providing Australian pet insurance policies to their customers. Their intriguing blog features posts on their policies, pet care plans, recovery systems, pet health tips, general information and more.

feeds.title: Pet Insurance Australia
feeds.description: Give your pet the health care they deserve! Pet Insurance Australia can help you and your pet take advantage of the latest in veterinary medicine and technology. A pet blog booming with funny, quirky and cute pet posts! Keep an eye on our blog, and receive your daily dose of fun posts, memes, pet advice, and tips!

feeds.title: Pet Insurance Blog
feeds.description: Get advice from licensed vets, helpful articles & learn about important pet health issues. Articles, videos, humor and how-to's to keep your pets happy.

feeds.title: Your Pet Insurance Guide
feeds.description: Your Pet Insurance Guide is helping pet owners and veterinarians understand how pet insurance works and the strategic role it can play in helping pay for a pet's healthcare expenses.

feeds.title: Pets Best Blog
feeds.description: Our staff of writers consists of veterinarians, behaviorists, and pet experts - covering topics from pet health, to training and behavior, to breed guides, and more! Pets Best Insurance was founded in 2005 by a veterinarian with a mission to help pets live long, happy, healthy lives. Pet health insurance plans for dogs and cats are available in all 50 states & D.C.

feeds.title: ASPCA Pet Insurance
feeds.description: The ASPCA Pet Health Insurance program discusses common pet insurance questions and shares a Pet Health Insurance Buyer's Guide. Founded in 1997, we're one of the original pet insurance providers in the U.S. ASPCA Pet Health Insurance plans are customizable to best fit your pet's health needs and your budgetary needs.

feeds.title: Prudent Pet Insurance Blog
feeds.description: Promoting the best possible care for pets and championing a simple approach to pet insurance. Explore pet care, pet stories, pet facts and trending pet news.
